## What was tried
Nothing has been built yet. The owner's rule (2026-11-23): every maintainer and every admin of the repository must always be allowed to approve issues for the issue watcher.

Today the approvers list is a local file (`~/.config/superclaude/issue-watch.d/<repo>-approvers.txt`, mode 600, not committed). `src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/generate.py` writes it once, from the fixed logins in the defaults plus `gh api repos/<repo>/collaborators?permission=maintain`, and then never touches it again (`approvers_file_exists`). Three gaps against the rule:
1. The list is never refreshed, so a maintainer promoted or demoted on GitHub is wrong until someone edits the file by hand.
2. `generate.py` (lines 243-245) removes the launch account from the generated list, so an admin who is also the launch account (here `ironbelly`) is not an approver. The owner's own approvals were ignored until the file was hand-edited on 2026-11-23.
3. `approval_of` (`src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/predicates.py`) checks the actor id only against the file's ids, never against the actor's current repository permission.

## Relevant files and links
- `src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/generate.py` (approver generation, launch-account exclusion)
- `src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/predicates.py` (`approval_of`)
- `src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/cycle.py` (`validate_approvers`, `load_config`, `approval_excluded_ids`)
- `src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/cli.py` (`check-config`, which warns `approver_is_launch_account`)
- Repo: IronbellyOrg/IronClaude. Live roles on 2026-11-23: admin `ironbelly`; maintain `clayphi`, `IB-JonathanB`.

## Done when
- A person with maintain or admin permission on the repo is always accepted as an approver, with no hand edit, and a person who loses that permission stops being accepted within one watcher cycle.
- The launch account counts when it holds admin or maintain; the existing `approval_excluded_ids` setting still lets the owner exclude any account on purpose.
- A GitHub read failure never approves anyone: the cycle falls back to the last good list or skips, and records why.
- Tests cover promotion, demotion, the launch account as admin, an excluded id, and a failed read.

## Pick-up note
The list is read-only input to a security check (it decides who may start work), so absent or failed evidence must never count as approval. Whether to read permissions live each cycle or refresh the file on a schedule is open; live reads add GitHub calls per cycle. The Orca project id for this repo shows the upstream, so pass no Orca link flags and use `--repo IronbellyOrg/IronClaude` on every gh call.

## Backlog review, 2026-11-24

Read-only review of this issue against the current source and its history (automated analysis, then an independent evidence review that passed).

- **State:** still-relevant
- **Complexity / size:** Medium / M
- **Priority:** P1

#### Concrete next steps
The exclusions, pure approval predicate and protected file reader are already implemented; role freshness and launch-admin generation are not. No implementation is authorized in this review.

1. Resolve effective maintain/admin membership at each watcher cycle through the existing GitHub runner boundary, supplying complete and validated evidence before either approval check. Keep the pure predicate free of network calls. Ensure promotions work and demoted users do not remain authorized solely through stale generated ids or fixed-login seeds. Existing configured installations must gain the new behavior without deleting their config or requiring hand edits.
2. Include a launch account with maintain/admin permission unless explicitly excluded. Preserve `approval_excluded_ids` as the overriding denial, human-actor validation and event timing. Update generator behavior and its old exclusion tests, plus the warnings in `/home/coder/workspaces/worktrees/IronClaude/Issuecleanup/src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/cli.py:214-224` and `/home/coder/workspaces/worktrees/IronClaude/Issuecleanup/src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/first_run.py:187-190` if their meaning changes under the new rule.
3. Verify the selected GitHub role endpoint and pagination rather than assuming the current maintain-filtered, ids-only, first-100 helper proves complete admin and maintainer coverage (`/home/coder/workspaces/worktrees/IronClaude/Issuecleanup/src/superclaude/cli/issue_watch/generate.py:117-126`, `:172-179`). Preserve bounded calls, deadline and rate-limit behavior. On failed, malformed or incomplete role evidence, prefer skipping approvals and recording a reason; this is the safe branch explicitly allowed by the issue. Do not treat a stale last-good membership set as proof that a demoted user is still eligible.
4. Add tests for promotion, demotion, launch account as admin, explicit exclusion, read failure, malformed/multi-page data, and an already-existing configuration. Keep both approval checks aligned and retain local file protections if the file remains. Existing tests are read-only evidence here, not executed results: `/home/coder/workspaces/worktrees/IronClaude/Issuecleanup/tests/issue_watch/test_generate.py:166-195` and `/home/coder/workspaces/worktrees/IronClaude/Issuecleanup/tests/issue_watch/test_predicates.py:96-112`.
5. Account for the separate issue-pipeline consumer before changing the file or validator contract: `/home/coder/workspaces/worktrees/IronClaude/Issuecleanup/src/superclaude/cli/issue_pipeline/cli.py:274` still reads the local ids. Preserve that interface or explicitly scope its migration; do not silently broaden plan-approval authority as part of this watcher fix.

#### Dependencies
No hard prerequisite or blocked-by issue is declared in issue 753, and none was established in the reviewed code or issue/PR reads. No downstream issue explicitly blocked by 753 was found. This is negative evidence within the bounded searches, not a complete repository dependency graph.

Issue [698](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/698), concerning plan-approval trust and release-worker protection, is related but not an established prerequisite: the watcher can obtain current roles without redesigning that separate approval gate. Coordinate interface changes with its owner rather than expanding this issue's scope.

#### Related issues
- [698](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/698), OPEN: plan-approval trust and a release-worker protection problem; its body describes a separate file/assignee-based approval policy. Its security claims were not reproduced here and remain UNVERIFIED by this review.
- [331](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/331), CLOSED: original automated issue-watcher feature, the origin of the existing poller. Closing that broad feature did not implement the later role-freshness requirement.
- [655](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/655), CLOSED: alternative issue-polling orchestrator work, historical context rather than an established dependency for this fix.

#### Related PRs
There is no PR mentioned or linked in the live body/comments of issue 753. Related implementation history found through explicit fork-only PR reads and local history:

- [707](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/pull/707), MERGED, commit `2ea524514154bde03258a7d7d8a0265c371609af`: zero-setup watcher, per-repository generator and Approved field; current source still contains its one-time membership and launch-account discard.
- [447](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/pull/447), MERGED, commit `4c93b6c7397e91b680b0306e99f32835bc364611`: original watcher; not a fix for current-role eligibility.
- [448](https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/pull/448), MERGED, commit `ce660825856185aa043f65dad34128e1a238b720`: protects the approvers-file open and rechecks probe deadlines. Preserve its file safeguards, not its static membership policy as a substitute for current role checks.

No fixing PR was found with the bounded `753`, open `maintainer`, and `admin approver` searches. Unpublished branches and unindexed references are UNVERIFIED. Nothing was posted, edited, linked or closed on GitHub.

_Limits: the full GitHub event timeline could not be read in this review and is unverified. Nothing was changed on this issue other than this comment and its field values._
